{{Quote|A couple years ago, I ran several GY-Is to the University at Rudrig (out in the Tion). These guys scrape together a fair number of credits from donations and tuition and are actually willing to pay a modest markup on educational materials. And it was kind of nice to make a run without getting shot at by Customs ships...|Roark Garnet|<ref name="cynabar" />}}
The '''University of Rudrig''', based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rudrig/Legends|Rudrig]] was the only [[University/Legends|university]] in the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]]. The university spanned the entirety of the planet Rudrig, offering a diverse array of programs and attracting a diverse variety of [[Species/Legends|species]]. As of [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], the university had started founding annex campuses on other worlds in the Tion Hegemony, including one on the planet [[Brigia/Legends|Brigia]].

==Description==
The [[University/Legends|University]] of Rudrig was an institution of higher learning located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rudrig/Legends|Rudrig]], in the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]].<ref name="cynabar" /> The university stretched across the entire planet, with multiple campuses, housing developments, recreation and field training sectors scattered across every region of Rudrig. Its expanse across the world was characterized with spires, domes and towers standing in harmony with Rudrig's natural foliage, and featured dozens of lecture halls, auditoriums, theaters, administrative buildings and clinics, along with a wide variety of classroom configurations. It also had a sprawling recreation center, which included a number of spas.<ref name="hll">''[[Han Solo and the Lost Legacy]]''</ref>

The only top-quality higher-education institution in the Tion Hegemony, the University of Rudrig attracted students from throughout that [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], drawing a diverse clientele of [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="hll" /> The university offered programs in a wide variety of subjects, from music<ref name="gundark">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref> to [[Xenoarchaeology/Legends|xenoarchaeology]]<ref name="tessent">{{GamerCite|9|Race for the Tessent}}</ref> to non-[[Human/Legends|Human]] ethnology.<ref name="hll" /> Although some of its departments were considered lazy and reactionary, many saw the University of Rudrig as offering a path forward from the Tion's grim past.<ref name="xim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref>

The university received most of its funding via donations and tuition, in turn using that money to purchase [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and other educational materials.<ref name="cynabar" /> The university also made it a mission to establish annex campuses on other worlds, maintaining a [[Committee for Interinstitutional Assistance]] to review and approve requests for financial aid from prospective planets. The [[Rudrig University Anthem]] was the school's signature song, and some local [[groundcoach]]es used the first two bars of the anthem as a warning horn.<ref name="hll" />

==History==
By the era of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the amount of income the university received from donations and tuition had grown quite sizable, enabling it to pay a modest markup for educational materials. However, it didn't always come about these materials by completely legal means&mdash;for instance, hiring [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] to deliver a shipment of [[GY-I information analysis droid]]s.<ref name="cynabar" /> By the era of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the university had started the process of building satellite campuses on other worlds around the Tion Hegemony. One of these new annexes was founded on [[Brigia/Legends|Brigia]] in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], to significant opposition from the planet's [[New Regime]].<ref name="hll" />

The University of Rudrig started a [[Studies in Contemporary Non-Human Music and Dance]] program during the early years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], requiring the purchase of a significant number of musical instruments.<ref name="gundark" /> The university formerly employed the controversial [[Xenoarchaeology/Legends|xenoarchaeologist]] [[Follnor Callat]], before expelling him and banning him from campus&mdash;however, Callat was still known to call on former students of his from Rudrig to assist him on treasure hunts.<ref name="tessent" /> [[Arhul Manaxa]], a scholar emeritus at the University of Rudrig, was considered a ranking expert on the early history of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] and the ancient [[Zhell–Taung war|Zhell–Taung War]] by [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].<ref name="egw">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut — The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The University of Rudrig first appeared in the novel ''[[Han Solo and the Lost Legacy]]'', written by [[Brian Daley]] and released in [[1980]].<ref name="hll" />
